# proxmox_node_network_interfaces (Data Source)

Lists the network interfaces of one node, including staged changes, from `/nodes/{node}/network`. `changes` carries the staged diff as reported by Proxmox.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_network_interfaces" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `changes` (String) Staged diff between `interfaces` and `interfaces.new`.
- `id` (String) Node name.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Interfaces sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean)
- `address` (String)
- `address6` (String)
- `autostart` (Boolean)
- `bridge_ports` (String)
- `cidr` (String)
- `cidr6` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `comments6` (String)
- `exists` (Boolean)
- `gateway` (String)
- `gateway6` (String)
- `iface` (String)
- `mtu` (Number)
- `ovs_bridge` (String)
- `type` (String)
